title: Cashfree launches a wallet that AI agents can spend from
summary: India's Cashfree launched a prepaid wallet under its RBI licence. Users fund it by UPI or card, then authorise personal AI agents to pay from it within budgets and rules they set. More than 100 agent builders integrated at launch.
whyItMatters: Budgets and rules built into a licensed wallet are one answer to the question of how far an agent may spend.
